questions.q: The direction cosines of the y-axis are —
P lies on the join of Q(2, 1, 2) and R(5, 2, 5). If the x-coordinate of P is 4, its z-coordinate is —
questions.work: x goes from 2 to 5; x = 4 means P is 2/3 of the way. z = 2 + (2/3)(5 − 2) = 4.

questions.q: (a) Find the distance of (2, 3, 6) from the origin. (b) Write the direction ratios of the line through (1, 2, 3) and (4, 0, 5).
A vector makes angles π/3 and π/2 with OX and OY. Find the angle it makes with OZ.
questions.answer: cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ = 1 ⇒ ¼ + 0 + cos²γ = 1 ⇒ cos γ = √3/2 (taking the acute angle) ⇒ γ = π/6.
